focusCardThreeBody: I work at a native-level proficiency with agentic AI coding tools to produce quality code at volumes far beyond what I could accomplish manually. I have developed the skills needed to evaluate AI-generated code for errors, orchestrate AI agents, and iterate to a production-ready state.
